summary.short: Amends Article 296 of Colombia's Penal Code: personal impersonation (falsedad personal) committed with artificial intelligence incurs a fine increased by up to one third. Also defines deepfake and directs public policy and AI case traceability. Amended provision effective one year after sanction.
summary.long: Law 2502 of 2025 amends Article 296 of Colombia's Penal Code (Law 599 of 2000), which penalises personal impersonation (falsedad personal) carried out to obtain a benefit or cause harm. The amendment adds that when the impersonation is carried out using artificial intelligence, the fine is increased by up to one third, provided the conduct does not constitute another crime. Article 2 defines DeepFake, identity, image and individuality. Article 4 requires the national government, the Fiscalía, the Police and the Ministry of Justice, with the ICT Ministry, to formulate within two years a public policy on harmful AI use, with minimum guidelines on ethics, inter-sector collaboration, education, R&D, algorithm transparency and governance including audits, international cooperation and rapid response. Article 5 requires the Fiscalía to keep traceable records of AI-enabled impersonation cases and to report annually to Congress. The Article 296 amendment takes effect one year after sanction; the rest of the law takes effect on sanction, promulgation and publication.

relations.note: Art. 3 modifies art. 296 (falsedad personal) and adds an inciso on falsedad personal committed with artificial intelligence; Art. 1 states the same object.

notes: Art. 6 makes the amendment to art. 296 effective one year after sanction and promulgation; the rest of the law takes effect on sanction, promulgation and publication. Art. 3 contains the typo 'muita' for 'multa' in the amended art. 296 text. Art. 4 parágrafo sets a two-year period for the listed actions. The law is dated 28 July 2025 and published in Diario Oficial No. 53.198 of 31 July 2025; the compilation-page metadata (last update 30 September 2026) is not part of the law text.

thresholds.note: No numeric cutoff in the operative provisions changes scope, eligibility, exemption, an obligation tier or a prohibition. The increase of the fine by up to one third when AI is used (Art. 3, inserting a paragraph into Art. 296 of Law 599 of 2000) is a penalty modifier and belongs under enforcement. The one-year delay in Art. 6 and the two-year period in the Art. 4 parágrafo are timing provisions, not thresholds.
